lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 3.2 identical across all four directions

north.notes: Kerf reads as a thin dark saw cut crossing the log top and upper flank; X-frames, pegs, and stringers all seat on real member lines; sawdust sits under the cut.

south.notes: Kerf slit wraps the visible top half a hair proud of the surface — a cut, not a fin or collar; both leg pairs and the low stringers contact ground and legs.

east.notes: Axis-on: the arc-profile slit follows the log cross-section with no protruding corners; end overhang and endgrain cap read as intended; crotch contact is believable.

west.notes: Axis-on from the thick end: the former square 'collar' corners are gone; the slit hugs the curvature; frames cross cleanly with pegs at the joints.

defectsFoundAndFixed: The first slit implementation (a straight box) poked square corners through both flanks in the east/west views, reading as a dark clamp; rebuilt as an arc-segment prism that follows the log's cross-section a hair proud of the surface.
